dedupe_keys.name: inei peru censos nacionales 2017 xii poblacion vii vivienda district redatam system with dwelling water supply days and hours of water service water provider sanitation public grid electricity and building materials

description: Peru's National Institute of Statistics and Informatics offers the 2017 National Censuses (XII Population, VII Housing) in a REDATAM web system at district level, where users build tables, graphs and maps from the full microdata. The dwelling dictionary covers type, occupancy, wall, roof and floor materials, rooms and tenure, and a detailed block on water: supply source, whether water arrives every day, how many hours per day, on how many days if not daily, whether the household pays and which company or entity it pays. It also records the sanitary service and whether the dwelling has electric lighting from the public grid. Geography runs from department to province and district, split by urban and rural area. Coverage is national. Format and access: free online processing without registration, with the census questionnaire as documentation; the 2025 census website is a JavaScript application and no 2025 tables or microdata were found on the pages read. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: district is the lowest geographic level in this base; service hours are as reported by households. Simulation uses: district level intermittency of water supply for network reliability and demand studies, provider identity for utility service areas, and grid electrification and building materials for exposure. Related records: the Panama census 2023 REDATAM with water service hours and the Honduras census 2013 housing volume and REDATAM.
